searchText: Hi guys, do you know any websites where I can read daily news happening in the web3 world? This Discord is for Ethereum R&D discussion. You can follow along with R&D discussions here. For the EF you can check their blog: https://blog.ethereum.org/ Otherwise check Twitter & Reddit (including following core devs & researchers from here).
